item.title: Met Office issues yellow weather warning for heavy rain and flooding
item.body: The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning for heavy rain and flooding in parts of the UK. The warning will be in place on Tuesday.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚠️ Met Office issues yellow weather warning for heavy rain and flooding

The Met Office has issued a yellow weather warning for heavy rain and flooding in parts of the UK. The warning will be in place on Tuesday.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 23 November, 17:20

#BreakingNews #WeatherWarning #UKWeather
